justification: Additive, static marketing page: a grouped human-readable site directory (/directory) linking existing pages, plus a footer link and a sitemap entry. No data, no DB, no new queries, no logic — only presentational JSX + a static link list. Minor, not Standard, because nothing computes a result or reads live data (council counts are read from the same static lib/lga-data arrays the sitemap already uses).

pre_impl.existing_data: Links only to routes verified to resolve (enumerated from app/ page.tsx routes). Council-count badges read from lib/lga-data/*_LGAS arrays — the same source app/sitemap.ts uses.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: If a linked route is later removed, the directory link 404s. Mitigated: links were checked against the actual static route list at build time; tsc passes. Council counts can never overstate — they are .length of the live arrays, so they track real coverage.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: New page + one footer link + one sitemap URL. Touches no existing rows, data, or behaviour.

functions: N/A — static server component, no functions added.
values: N/A — no DB/API values; static link list + array .length counts.

break_it.scenario: A directory card links to a route that does not resolve (e.g. a bare tool hub like /flood-risk which is LGA-only), sending users to a 404.
break_it.what_happens: A user clicks a listed page and hits a 404 — the directory would be actively misleading.
break_it.how: frontend-nextjs/app/site-directory/page.tsx links only routes confirmed present in app/ (the per-address tools point at their /reports/* hub, which exists, and to /browse for per-council pages) — NOT the bare LGA-only hubs. tsc --noEmit passes on the file.
break_it.repro: Enumerate app/**/page.tsx static routes and diff against the hrefs in GROUPS — every href is present.

break_it.scenario: A council-count badge overstates coverage (says more councils than are live).
break_it.what_happens: A visitor is misled about how many councils a tool covers.
break_it.how: Counts are `${X_LGAS.length}` read directly from lib/lga-data arrays (same source as app/sitemap.ts), so the badge equals actual coverage and updates automatically when arrays change.
break_it.repro: Compare a badge to the array length used by sitemap.ts for that tool.

post_merge.other_repo: No — plotdetect info-site directory is handled separately in lmcdo/website.
post_merge.manual_verify: Open /site-directory on the preview; confirm every card link resolves and the footer 'Site directory' link appears site-wide.
